_note: One entry per character/thing. names = gu/hi/en. 'look' (English) is required only for characters used in a picture 'who' list: it keeps their face and clothes the same in every picture.

arjun.look: handsome Indian prince, medium-brown skin, large expressive dark eyes, curly shoulder-length black hair half tied up, small gold crown (mukut) with one peacock feather, golden-yellow dhoti with a maroon sash, gold armlets and a pearl necklace, carries the golden bow Gandiva decorated with peacock-feather patterns. As a child (age 8): same face, round cheeks, hair in a small topknot, simple yellow dhoti, a tiny wooden bow

bhishma.look: tall majestic elderly warrior-sage, long white beard and white hair, maroon and gold armour with a white shawl, a long bow, calm noble face. As a young prince Devavrata (age 16): same face without beard, black hair, simple royal clothes

chanakya.look: thin wise scholar-teacher, shaved head with a long topknot (shikha), white dhoti and shawl, sharp kind eyes, holds a palm-leaf manuscript

dronacharya.look: dignified elderly teacher, white beard and moustache, topknot, saffron robe with a white shawl, rudraksha beads, kind but stern eyes, holds a long bow

eklavya.look: young tribal forest prince (age 14), dark skin, thick black hair tied with a green headband, simple forest clothes with feather ornaments, a handmade wooden bow, determined face

shabari.look: very old tribal woman, white hair in a bun, wrinkled kind face, simple saffron-brown saree, a leaf basket of berries, glowing devoted smile

ganesh.look: child-friendly Lord Ganesh, elephant head with one tusk, big kind eyes, red-and-yellow dhoti, golden crown, round belly, four arms holding a modak, an axe, a lotus and a blessing hand, a small friendly mouse nearby

hanuman.look: mighty Hanuman with a golden-orange furry body and a monkey face, red mace (gada) on his shoulder, golden crown and earrings, red loincloth, long tail, kind devoted eyes

indra.look: king of the gods, golden crown, white and gold royal clothes, holds a golden thunderbolt (vajra), sits on the white four-tusked elephant Airavat

janak.look: wise king with a grey beard, simple saffron robe over royal clothes, modest gold crown, kind eyes

krishna.look: blue-skinned Lord Krishna, gentle smile, large lotus-shaped eyes, golden crown with a peacock feather, yellow pitambar dhoti, flower garland, gold ornaments, a bamboo flute. As a child (age 5): same face, round cheeks, small peacock feather, butter on his cheeks. As charioteer he holds the reins of four white horses

laxman.look: young prince with golden-brown skin, hair in a topknot, simple yellow-green forest robes, a bow and quiver, alert loyal eyes

meera.look: young Rajasthani queen-saint, long dark hair, white and pink saree with a gold border, tulsi garland, holds an ektara (one-stringed instrument), joyful devoted face

narad.look: celestial sage, white beard, matted topknot, saffron robes, rudraksh garland, holds a veena and small cymbals, often floating lightly on a cloud

prahlad.look: little boy about 7, bright eyes, small gold crown, yellow dhoti, tulsi garland, folded hands, innocent brave face

sita.look: graceful Sita, long dark hair with a flower, soft yellow and pink saree with a gold border, gentle strong face, a lotus in her hand

ram.look: blue-skinned Lord Ram, calm gentle smile, golden crown, saffron-yellow dhoti, a long bow, noble face. During exile: matted hair topknot and simple bark-cloth clothes

shravan.look: young humble man, simple white dhoti, a kavad (bamboo pole with two baskets) on his shoulders, gentle devoted face

tapasya.look: elderly sage with long white hair and beard, saffron cloth, sitting in lotus position with closed eyes, rudraksh beads, a glowing peaceful aura

bhagirath.look: royal sage-king in simple saffron robes with a small gold crown set aside, lean strong body from penance, rudraksh beads, determined peaceful face, standing on one leg or sitting in meditation

uma.look: Goddess Parvati (Uma), fair golden-brown skin, red saree with a gold border, crown and flowers, a small bindi, peaceful loving face

vishwakarma.look: divine architect, strong creative man with a rich crown, golden-yellow robes, holds a measuring rod, hammer and compass, a toolbox

puja.look: a happy Indian child (age 7) in a simple kurta, folded hands, in front of a lit diya, a brass puja thali with flowers and incense

vashishtha.look: calm smiling sage with long white hair and beard, white robes, rudraksh beads, serene glowing eyes

yudhishthira.look: tall calm king, medium-brown skin, simple white and gold royal robes, modest gold crown, kind truthful eyes, a gentle smile

kunti.look: gentle royal mother, warm kind eyes, white and soft-pink saree with a gold border, a light veil over her head, simple gold jewellery

draupadi.look: graceful princess in a red and gold bridal saree, long black hair with flowers, a flower garland in her hands, dignified calm smile

brahma.look: four-faced Lord Brahma with a white beard, red-gold robes, seated on a lotus, holds the Vedas, a water pot (kamandalu) and a rosary, a white swan nearby

vishnu.look: blue-skinned Lord Vishnu with four arms holding a conch, a discus (Sudarshan chakra), a mace and a lotus, golden crown, yellow pitambar, flower garland

shiva.look: Lord Shiva (Mahadev), pale blue-grey skin, matted hair with a crescent moon and the river Ganga flowing from it, a third eye, a serpent around the neck, tiger-skin cloth, a trident (trishul) and a damaru drum, calm meditative face

kartikeya.look: young Lord Kartikeya (Murugan), handsome boy-warrior, golden crown, holds a spear (vel), rides a colourful peacock

durga.look: Goddess Durga, kind and strong face, red saree with gold, ten arms holding weapons and a lotus, rides a gentle lion

lakshmi.look: Goddess Lakshmi, golden-pink skin, red and gold saree, seated on a lotus, one hand holding a lotus, gold coins falling from the other, two elephants pouring water behind her

saraswati.look: Goddess Saraswati, white saree, seated on a white lotus, holds a veena, a book and a rosary, a white swan nearby

radha.look: graceful young woman Radha in a blue-and-pink lehenga, flowers in her hair, gentle devoted smile, a peacock feather nearby

matsya.look: a giant golden fish with a gentle wise face and a small gold crown, with a glow of Lord Vishnu around it

kurma.look: a giant golden tortoise with a calm wise face and a small gold crown, a mountain resting on its shell

varaha.look: strong blue-skinned figure with a boar's head, gold crown, lifting the Earth (a glowing globe with a gentle goddess Bhudevi) on his tusks

narasimha.look: Narasimha, half-lion half-man, golden mane, blue-gold body, golden crown, powerful but kind (not scary) face, child-friendly

vamana.look: small young boy-sage Vamana, shaved head with a topknot, saffron cloth, holds an umbrella and a water pot, glowing smile; in his giant form he grows tall as the sky

parshurama.look: sage-warrior Parshurama, matted hair, saffron-brown clothes, holds a battle-axe (parashu), strong serious face

buddha.look: peaceful Gautama Buddha, simple saffron robes, seated in meditation under a Bodhi tree, serene smile, soft light

kalki.look: future hero Kalki on a white horse, golden armour, a blazing sword, shining crown, bright heroic face
